text:
Nadia: Quick check-in post-launch 30m — we need 2-3 low-risk follow-on items for the next two sprints: small customer pain fixes, grooming, and clear rollbacks. Anyone? :wave:

Omar: My shortlist: 1) API transient 429 retry (edge), 2) streaming UI shows stuck state, 3) revert small embed postprocess for 3 affected orgs (canary).

Bea: +1. Prioritize things with explicit rollback paths. For revert, suggest per-org model pin + 10% traffic canary for 48h.

Nadia: Good. Draft ACs: API retry -> "<1% 429s per org in 24h; p99 latency delta <20%". Streaming UI -> "show last-chunk timestamp + try link after 7s". Embed revert -> "per-org eval set shows improvement of precision@5 by >3pt or abort".

Cory: Dev estimates: retry = 8h (edge + tests), streaming copy = 2h, embed canary = 2 days (ML+ops).

InfraBot: [canary] Canary job created for API retry patch. Window 2h, auto-rollback on p99+error_threshold.

Omar: Ops guardrail: if p95 rises >25% abort. We'll also run synthetic retry checks every 30s during canary.

Bea: I'll run the grooming session and add a "rollback plan" checklist to backlog PR template. Loom tomorrow.

Nadia: Owners? Omar take retry? Bea take grooming? Cory pair on QA harness?

Omar: I'll pick up retry and the canary orchestration.

Cory: I'll do QA harness and the synthetic tests.

Bea: I'll post the Loom + rubric and add rollback checkbox.

Nadia: Recap: owners assigned; ship targets: retry (1 day), streaming UX (0.5 day), embed canary (2 days). I'll create sprint slices now and tag owners. Flag scope issues here within 6h. :thumbsup:
